Here's the draft comparison for Meridian Healthcare — **no pricing approved, nothing final**:

**Plan:** 12 weeks — Foundation (1–4) → Rollout (5–10) → Optimization (11–12), covering infrastructure, deployment, training, and go-live support.

**Pricing snapshot (draft only):**
| Component | List | Proposed | Savings |
|---|---|---|---|
| Software | $681K | $620K | 9% |
| Implementation | $382K | $340K | 11% |
| Training/Support | $293K | $220K | 25% |
| **Total** | **$1.356M** | **$1.18M** | **13%** |

- Fits under the $1.25M budget ceiling with $70K headroom
- Draft margin shown at 42% (target 40%+)
